author: cdc-rfc1-author (Claude Sonnet 5.5)
rationale: Single clk_io wrapper with registered inputs and outputs; every port is contracted to clk_io and the reset is synchronous and contracted. No crossing or boundary obligation.

author_reading.rationale: Fully registered single-clock (clk_io) boundary with synchronous reset, every input and output constrained.

labels.rationale: The arithmetic body is modeled directly in RTL. Input registers, adder result, and valid output use clk_io with matching boundary timing.

Single-clock registered adder macro with all input registers (a_q, b_q, v_q) and synchronously reset output registers (sum_q, valid_q) clocked by clk_io and all boundary ports covered by set_input_delay and set_output_delay on clk_io.
